sources_checked_2026_11_28: CIA history 'The Central Intelligence Agency and Overhead Reconnaissance: The U-2 and OXCART Programs, 1954-1974', declassified Aug 2013: first official acknowledgement of Area 51; U-2 silver wings caught the sun when the ground below was dark
CIA study by Gerald Haines (1997), via the New York Times: over half of all UFO reports from the late 1950s through the 1960s were accounted for by manned reconnaissance flights
CIA post, Dec 29, 2014: 'Reports of unusual activity in the skies in the '50s? It was us.'
1989 KLAS-TV interview (Bob Lazar, face hidden) claiming work on nine flying saucers near the base; not named in the video
Storm Area 51 Facebook event: about 2 million 'going'; AP, Sept 20, 2019: about 75 people at the gate, none got past it (NPR: about 40); about 1,500 at the festivals
